title: Implement derived governance context selection

requirement.summary: Start Phase 1 by giving a coding agent task-relevant repository governance before implementation.

objective.rationale: This is the first Phase 1 vertical slice approved after the product and architecture review.

goal: Derive a read-only repository governance registry and stable task-specific context output with provenance and selection reasons.
non_goals: Do not implement changed-file scope failure, event persistence, fresh evidence, dashboard, hooks, or automatic governance-file edits.
Do not add an editable registry or use full-text semantic inference to select architecture.
Do not commit, push, publish, release, or modify AI Radar.
acceptance_signals: An admitted task produces deterministic JSON, Markdown, and terminal context containing only selected governance with reason and provenance.
Compact and standard task profiles validate through the same task contract without allowing natural-language scope to become a failure rule.
Skill triggers and applicability remain owned by SKILL.md rather than a registry mapping file.
A real Coding Agent consumes the generated context for one small task and the observed adherence and noise limitations are recorded.
Focused and complete tests pass and context selection does not modify repository or Git state.

items: Over-selection could make context too noisy for a coding agent.
A hidden routing map would duplicate artifact-owned declarations.
Changing the preview task schema requires migrating all repository fixtures together.

stop_conditions: Stop if selection requires semantic architecture judgment to be presented as deterministic.
Stop if the design requires a persistent editable Registry or automatic repository mutation.
Stop if unrelated user worktree changes cannot be preserved.

decision.rationale: The user approved the reviewed plan and explicitly instructed development to start.
